name: Taiping Half Marathon 2026
short_description: The Taiping Half Marathon 2026 is a 21.1km half marathon held on August 9, 2026 at Dataran Warisan, Taiping, Perak, Malaysia.
ai_summary: The Taiping Half Marathon 2026 takes place on August 9, 2026, at Dataran Warisan in Taiping, Perak, Malaysia. Runners can choose between 5km, 10km, and 21.1km distances, with the 21.1km half marathon serving as the event's primary race. Registration is currently open for participants interested in joining this Perak-based race.
pros: Multiple distance options (5km, 10km, and 21.1km) accommodate different runner levels
Registration is currently open, giving participants time to prepare
Set in Dataran Warisan, a notable landmark venue in Taiping, Perak

excerpt_quotes.quote: This was my first half-marathon in such intense heat and humidity, so I started conservatively. It's not a personal best, but it's definitely a strong performance under these conditions
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Vivien Ng (2025 women's 21km winner), quoted in ToughASIA race report

excerpt_quotes.quote: This race is AIMS-certified, which was a big reason I decided to take part
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Runner quoted in ToughASIA coverage of the 2025 edition

excerpt_quotes.quote: Organising a race like this is always a team effort, and I'm proud of how the entire Taiping community came together to deliver such a seamless experience for our runners
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Race director Ahmad Azri, quoted in ToughASIA

excerpt_quotes.quote: The flag-off was perfectly on time. No pushing, no chaos.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Runner race report on chrisywong.com blog

excerpt_quotes.quote: One hell of a painful lesson but we go again.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Runner post on Threads recapping the 2025 race

research_highlights: The 21km flags off very early (4:30am in the 2025/2026 editions) with 10km at 6:30am and 5km at 7am, largely to get runners through before the day heats up.
The half-marathon route passes through Taiping Lake Gardens and the colonial-era Jalan Taming Sari before looping through Kamunting and Bukit Jana, per race-day coverage of the 2025 edition.
2025's 21km course had a total elevation gain of about 89 metres, with climbs noted particularly around Tekah and Kamunting before a flat finish back to the town centre.
The race is AIMS-certified, which some competitive runners cited as a reason for choosing it.
Cut-off times for the 2026 edition are listed as 4:50 hrs for the 21km, 2:50 hrs for the 10km, and 2 hrs for the 5km.
research_watchouts: Multiple runners in 2025 described heat and humidity as a real challenge on course, even prompting a conservative pacing strategy from a sub-elite finisher.
At least one participant reported an unexpectedly hard day out, finishing well off their normal pace and describing the race as a 'painful lesson', with legs still sore days later.
One social post noted a 4:30-pace pacer group was seen walking rather than running during the race, suggesting pacing group execution wasn't always consistent.

faqs.question: When is the Taiping Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Taiping Half Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on August 9, 2026. It will be held at Dataran Warisan in Taiping, Perak, Malaysia. faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Taiping Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Taiping Half Marathon 2026 offers three distance categories: 5km, 10km, and 21.1km. The 21.1km half marathon serves as the event's primary distance, making it the featured race, while the shorter 5km and 10km options allow runners of varying experience levels to participate in the event as well.

faqs.question: Where is the Taiping Half Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: This race is held at Dataran Warisan, located in Taiping, Perak, Malaysia. The venue serves as the central location for the event, hosting the 5km, 10km, and 21.1km distance categories. Its location in Perak makes it accessible for both local runners and visitors traveling to Taiping for the race.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Taiping Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Taiping Half Marathon 2026 is currently open. Prospective participants interested in the 5km, 10km, or 21.1km distances can sign up now ahead of the race date on August 9, 2026, at Dataran Warisan in Taiping, Perak, Malaysia.
